Game Overview

Blacko Ball 2 is a ball game built around dodge spikes and saws in the thrilling sequel, Blacko Ball 2. Master 2D platforming challenges across eight levels, collecting red balls while evading cunning enemies. Use strategic double jumps for navigating tricky sections and reach the exit in this engaging mix of strategy and reflexes.
